features.name: Enhanced sales order agent
features.description: Enhancements to the existing sales order agent to capture more sales with AI-powered capabilities. General availability in October 2025.

features.name: MCP server for Business Central
features.description: Connect AI agents to Business Central through MCP server. MCP is an open API standard that enables intelligent clients to discover, describe and invoke operations. This allows agents to connect to existing knowledge sources and APIs.

features.name: Advanced Tell Me search
features.description: Advanced search functionality in Tell Me that uses AI to find pages and reports. Users can type search terms and get results based on AI-powered search capabilities.
features.status_evidence_quote: Feature management. And yes, advance. Tell me more. Tell me preview. Uh, let's turn it on here for all users.
caveats: Needs to be enabled through feature management

features.name: Autofill with Copilot field suggestions
features.description: Enhanced autofill capabilities using Copilot to get better field suggestions. When in a customer record, users can click a sparkle icon to ask Copilot to auto-fill specific fields.

features.name: Payables agent contextual invoice drafts
features.description: Payables agent provides more contextual invoice drafts using AI to analyze purchase invoices and generate better draft suggestions.

features.name: Agent task instructions enhancement
features.description: Users can give more instructions to agents when reviewing their tasks, improving communication between the user and the agent.
caveats: Works with both sales order agent and payables agent

features.name: Match purchase invoices to orders with payables agent
features.description: The payables agent will be able to match purchase invoices with purchase orders or sales orders automatically.

features.name: Payables agent confidence level prioritization
features.description: Prioritize invoice draft changes using payables agent confidence levels to help users focus on the most reliable suggestions.

features.name: Copilot emissions suggestions in sustainability
features.description: Copilot can suggest gas emissions in sustainability journals, helping users enter sustainability accounts and track emissions data.

features.name: Summarize with Copilot enhancements
features.description: Enhancements to the existing Summarize feature with quicker generation of summaries, consistent use of currency codes, and expansion to 20 more languages beyond English.

features.name: Copilot billing type configuration
features.description: Billing type for copilot and agent capabilities can be set to Microsoft build, custom build, or undefined depending on the AI resource. Can be configured using the register capability function or modify capability in AL.

features.name: Azure resources for Copilot extensions
features.description: Use Azure resources for copilot extensions. Developers can use default KPI resources in AL through set manage resource authorization or configure their own Azure OpenAI subscription.

features.name: Enhanced analysis assist with Copilot
features.description: Enhancements to the existing Analysis Assist feature. Users can perform ad hoc analysis on list pages and ask Copilot to design analysis views.

features.name: Enhanced chat with Copilot - 20 languages
features.description: Enhanced chat with Copilot now supports 20 languages with better understanding of user prompts containing multiple synthesis or intents, faster performance and increased reliability.

features.name: Payables agent in more countries
features.description: Payables agent expansion to more countries with a November 2025 release date.

features.name: VAT enhancements for Checka
features.description: VAT enhancements and total amounts on purchase advances for Checka with payment reporting and UK localization as an extension.

features.name: Contoso coffee demo data for Checka
features.description: Contoso coffee demo data set added for Checka localization.

features.name: 1099 forms electronic submission
features.description: 1099 forms can be submitted electronically to IRS in the US.

features.name: Cancel build and publish from Visual Studio
features.description: The ability to cancel build or cancel publishing from Visual Studio, useful for large extensions to avoid waiting and making changes before republishing.

features.name: Extend copilot auto field using AL
features.description: Ability to subscribe to an event and add custom logic using AI or other methods to have compiled values for a specific field in Copilot auto field.

features.name: Hide copilot summaries
features.description: Copilot summaries can be hidden on custom pages, custom objects, page extensions or hidden for specific user profiles.

features.name: Enhanced page scripting tool
features.description: Enhanced page scripting tool with ability to delete arbitrary steps, define script parameters in the UI, and create a suite of scripts in the UI.

features.name: Truncate table data using new methods
features.description: New methods to truncate table data with support for tables with media and media set fields, usable inside try functions, and with filters on flow fields.
caveats: cannot truncate tables with on delete triggers or event subscriptions
cannot truncate with filters on flow fields

features.name: View SQL core per information in performance profiles
features.description: Ability to view SQL core per information in performance profiles for analyzing query performance.

features.name: Create multiple fixed asset cards
features.description: Ability to create multiple fixed asset cards when posting a purchase invoice to streamline asset management processes.

features.name: Contoso coffee demo data for Instat
features.description: New Contoso coffee demo data set available for Instat.

features.name: Audit trail report
features.description: New audit trail report to improve compliance by giving a detailed and transparent record of all transactions. Available in November 2025.
caveats: not yet available in this release

features.name: Accounts payable role center
features.description: New accounts payable role center that simplifies workflows by centralizing all related documents and tasks in one place, making it easier to handle purchase documents, inbound e-documents and payments.

features.name: Automate environment management with power platform connector
features.description: Power platform connector for the business central admin center API enables automation of environment management tasks including creating environments, copying environments and scheduling environment operations.

features.name: Migrate record links and notes with cloud migration tooling
features.description: Cloud migration now allows migration of record links and notes from on-premises NAV or BC to cloud environments, ensuring business context and extra information is preserved during migration.

features.name: Enhanced financial reports
features.description: Enhanced financial reports with demoted fields, autofill number in description following definitions, notifications to update definitions, move name fields up in descriptions to cards, support dynamic naming for column headings and use column definitions in both local currency and additional reporting currencies.

features.name: Purchasing analytics improvements
features.description: Purchasing analytics has been improved in this wave.

features.name: Enhanced PowerBI sales app and modernized reports
features.description: Enhanced PowerBI sales app and modernized reports in sales analytics.

features.name: Personalization of supply chain pages
features.description: Add more fields in columns by personalizing pages in supply chain management.

features.name: Statistics group for card pages
features.description: Statistics group for item card, vendor card, customer card.

features.name: Configure default consumption calculation
features.description: Configure the default calculation for the calculate consumption report in manufacturing setup with options for actual output or expected output.

features.name: Quality management extension
features.description: New quality management extension for Business Central helps you comply within the standards regulator requirements including quality checks on incoming goods and materials.

features.name: Concurrent inventory posting with line sorting
features.description: If you enable concurrent inventory posting, it processes lines by type and number, sorting lines to reduce likelihood of deadlocks when two sessions post at the same time.
caveats: This change might affect extensions that rely on expected value in next or previous lines

features.name: Subcontracting capabilities in production
features.description: Expand Business Central solution to meet local needs by adding capabilities that include logistic flows managing contractor transfers of materials, components, flexible pricing, and finished goods receipts with item tracking.
caveats: Already in Italian localization, now included in W1 solution

features.name: Resizable copilot help panes
features.description: User can adjust width of copilot help and page scripting panes by dragging the divider between main content to get extra room for information inside pages with copilot help.
caveats: Feature may not yet be fully accessible as of September 2025
